vibe_rationale: Streetwear retail fair at IFEMA with mass-market sponsors and little community programming; subculture is the theme, not the core.
fit_notes: Large young-adult streetwear buyers with little wellness adjacency, though non-endemic brands such as Porsche and Mahou have sponsored and the door is open. A recovery or hydration activation would be a reach play, and a local partner would be needed.
